text.tspan: Monthly crude oil production, Jan 1, 1973 to Dec 1, 2025
Data source: U.S. Energy Information Administration (2026)
Note: Monthly production is allocated to the first day of each month: so, December 2019 production is allocated to 1st December 2019. This
includes the production of crude oil, including lease condensate.
